sections.name: body
sections.value:
- Supersedes the 'TAKIN TRAP' bullet in the 2026-11-18 start note: F196 is live, so send to pij-amazing-takin directly. Don't relay through the prime.
- Lanes: s02 sidecar = pij-charming-crane (coder/228, worktree fleet-228-cache-proxy-sidecar). s03 daemon gate = pij-yielding-newt (coder/229, fleet-229-cache-proxy-gate, migration 0047 claimed by pm-004). Both build only into PIJ_SHARED_TARGET=/Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/target-ws004 via just shared-build.
- The status-route contract is blueprint 003 c-status-route, plus crane's type rules (since in epoch ms; null account/host; reason/fix "" when ready; the failure-to-state mapping; `off` keeps serving existing seats). pm-004 owns changes to it and must tell both lanes.
- req-13 (-1m → base id; MODEL_ID and MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS env) is split: the proxy half in s02, the spawn half in s03.
- Docs PR #238 (PRD 004, blueprint 003, workstream 004) is the prime's to merge. Reviewers per PR are Copilot gpt-6.1-sol seats, two rounds at most.
